subject: Tiếng Anh
module_model: Bài học → Bài tập theo Unit (độc lập Khám phá) → Ôn tập

rules.bai_hoc: 16 lessons follow the 16 textbook Units. English is primary; Vietnamese support is selective. Textbook-aligned phonics, vocabulary and sentence patterns are preserved where necessary.
rules.bai_tap: Exactly 20 individually authored questions in each of 16 SGK Units, separately stored by semester; practice is independent of Khám phá.
rules.unlock: Exercise 1 is open. Score at least 80% (16 correct out of 20) in an exercise to unlock the next exercise. Server must verify this condition.
rules.assessment: Keep ENG_PHO, ENG_VOC, ENG_LIS, ENG_GRA, ENG_SYN and ENG_READ. A competency with no valid sample is Not enough data / Chưa đủ dữ liệu.
rules.images: Images are referenced via shared_image_catalog.json image_id; unit illustration is supplementary. Do not display an answer-revealing image for listening items.
rules.tts: English: en-US. Standalone 100% Vietnamese: vi-VN. Vietnamese translation/support below English: silent. Mixed English-Vietnamese strings: never read as one string.

language_policy.display_rule: English first; selected Vietnamese meaning/support below.
language_policy.tts_rule: Read English with en-US. Vietnamese TTS is allowed only for standalone 100% Vietnamese content. Vietnamese lines that are merely translations/support under English are visual-only and are not read. Never send a mixed English-Vietnamese string to one TTS voice.
language_policy.sgk_exception: Textbook-aligned Unit titles, phonics targets, key vocabulary and sentence patterns may keep textbook wording/spelling when pedagogically necessary.

content_audit.scope: JSON data and answer structure only; no live UI or backend tests
